\begin{table*}[t]

\caption{Single-frame localization. Recall in \%. $\checkmark$ denotes our acoustic verification. Acoustic candidates are always rendered from the floorplan; the \emph{query acoustics} column gives the geometry the observation itself was rendered on. Replica offers a furnished scan, so its query carries the furniture the floorplan does not model, which is the gap this method addresses. Structured3D ships no furnished mesh, so its query can only come from the same floorplan proxy as the candidates, which removes that gap and makes the acoustic side substantially easier; its rows are not comparable to Replica's on equal terms. Datasets without impulse responses are left empty rather than filled from a visual-only run.}
